policy: Format metadata only. freeRoms lists freely redistributable test/homebrew suites; bep never fetches commercial games (see roms.json).

statusLegend.parsed: an in-repo owner parses or executes the format
statusLegend.identified: in-repo code only sniffs magic or registers the extension
statusLegend.external-only: handled by external tools listed in packages/iecode-docs/nie/CONSOLE-PIPELINE.md (ctrtool, 3dstool, ninfs, Wiimms ISO Tools)

formats.header: 16-byte header: PRG 16K units @4, CHR 8K units @5, flags6 (mirroring, battery, trainer, mapper low), flags7 (mapper high, NES 2.0 when (b7 & 0x0C) == 0x08); 512-byte trainer if flags6 bit 2
32-byte header then chunked blocks (MAPR, PRG0..F, CHR0..F, MIRR, BATR)

magic.note: optional fwNES 16-byte header; byte 4 = side count

formats.header: 65500-byte sides of blocks 1 (disk info), 2 (file count), 3 (file header), 4 (file data); .qd keeps CRCs and 65536-byte sides
0x80-byte header: version @5, song count @6, load/init/play addresses @8/@0xA/@0xC

magic.note: no magic; locate internal header at 0x7FC0 (LoROM), 0xFFC0 (HiROM) or 0x40FFC0 (ExHiROM), +0x200 when size % 1024 == 512 (copier header)

formats.header: Internal header: title 21 bytes, map mode +0x15, chip type +0x16, ROM/RAM size +0x17/+0x18, region +0x19, checksum complement +0x1C and checksum +0x1E sum to 0xFFFF; vectors at +0x20
SPC700 registers @0x25, ID666 tag @0x2E, 64 KiB ARAM @0x100, DSP registers @0x10100

magic.note: first 8 bytes of the 48-byte Nintendo logo

formats.header: Entry 0x100, title 0x134, CGB flag 0x143 (0x80/0xC0), SGB flag 0x146, cartridge type 0x147, ROM size 0x148 (32 KiB << n), RAM size 0x149, header checksum 0x14D, global checksum 0x14E
0x70-byte header with load/init/play addresses
ARM branch @0, logo 0x04..0x9F, title 0xA0 (12), game code 0xAC (4), maker 0xB0 (2), unit 0xB3, version 0xBC, complement check 0xBD; multiboot images (.mb) load at 0x02000000

magic.note: Nintendo logo; logo CRC16 at 0x15C = 0xCF56, header CRC16 at 0x15E

formats.header: 0x200 header (0x1000 on DSi): title 0x00, game code 0x0C, maker 0x10, unit code 0x12, ARM9 rom offset/entry/load/size 0x20..0x2F, ARM7 0x30..0x3F, FNT 0x40/0x44, FAT 0x48/0x4C, ARM9/ARM7 overlay tables 0x50/0x58, banner offset 0x68, secure-area CRC 0x6C
Extended header 0x180..0xFFF: region flags, ARM9i/ARM7i offsets 0x1C0/0x1D0, modcrypt areas 0x220..0x22F, SHA-1 HMACs, RSA signature at 0xF80
Nitro generic header: magic, BOM, version, file size, header size, block count; NARC = BTAF/BTNF/GMIF blocks
u32 header: type in low byte, decompressed size in upper 24 bits (BIOS SWI 0x11-0x18 formats)
RSA-2048 signature 0x000, media size 0x104 (0x200-byte media units), media ID 0x108, partition FS types 0x110, crypt types 0x118, partition table 0x120 (8 x offset/length), card info 0x200

Partition ID 0x108, program ID 0x118, flags 0x188 (crypto, content type), ExHeader at 0x200 (size 0x180), plain region 0x190, logo 0x198, ExeFS offset/size 0x1A0/0x1A4, RomFS 0x1B0/0x1B4 (media units)

magic.note: archive header size 0x2020 (u32 LE), type 0, version 0

formats.header: Cert chain size 0x08, ticket size 0x0C, TMD size 0x10, meta size 0x14, content size 0x18 (u64), content index bitmap 0x20; sections 64-byte aligned

magic.note: ExeFS: 10 x (name[8], offset, size) then SHA-256 hashes; no magic
RomFS level-3 hash tree, version 0x10000 at 0x4

formats.header: ExeFS holds .code (LZ-reverse compressed when ExHeader flag set), icon, banner, logo
Header size 0x20 (0x2C with extended SMDH/RomFS offsets), relocation header size, code/rodata/data/bss sizes
16 x 0x200 application titles, settings 0x2008, 24x24 and 48x48 RGB565 tiled icons
NW4C/CTR SDK containers

PI config 0x00, clock 0x04, entry point 0x08, libultra version 0x0C, CRC1/CRC2 0x10/0x14, title 0x20 (20 bytes), game code 0x3B (category, ID, region), version 0x3F, IPL3 boot code 0x40..0xFFF (CIC-specific)

magic.note: no magic; system area in first blocks

formats.header: Retail .ndd = 64DD disk image (SA + user blocks)
Game ID 0x00 (6), disc number 0x06, version 0x07, name 0x20, DOL offset 0x420, FST offset/size 0x424/0x428; bi2.bin at 0x440, apploader at 0x2440
Partition info table at 0x40000, region settings 0x4E000; partitions hold ticket, TMD (size 0x2A4, offset>>2 0x2A8), H3, AES-128-CBC data in 0x8000 clusters (0x400 hashes + 0x7C00 data)
Header1 0x48 (ISO size 0x24), Header2: disc type, compression (zstd/lzma/bzip2), chunk size, disc header copy, partition and group tables
Sector counts, hd/wbfs sector shift, disc table; per-disc wlba table

magic.note: block size u32 LE at 0x4, 0x7FF8-byte block map

formats.header: Sparse block image
Compressed size, data size, block size, block count, block pointer and hash tables
Embedded GC image with FST/DOL offsets
Cert chain size 0x08, ticket 0x10, TMD 0x14, data 0x18, footer 0x1C; sections 64-byte aligned, contents AES-encrypted with title key
7 text + 11 data section file offsets (0x00), load addresses (0x48), sizes (0x90); BSS address/size 0xD8/0xDC; entry 0xE0
Machine 0x12: PowerPC (20) for GC/Wii/Wii U, MIPS (8) for PS1/PS2/PSP (PSP Allegrex flags 0x00A2xxxx), ARM (40) for DS/3DS

magic.note: Yaz0 RLE wrapper; decompressed size at 0x4

formats.header: U8: root node offset 0x4, node table size 0x8, data offset 0xC; 12-byte nodes
TPL: image count 0x4, image table offset 0x8; GX tiled formats I4/I8/IA4/IA8/RGB565/RGB5A3/RGBA8/CI4/CI8/CI14x2/CMPR

magic.note: GCI: 0x40-byte directory entry starting with game code; Wii data.bin is AES-encrypted with the SD key

formats.header: GC memory card: 5 system blocks (header, directory x2, BAT x2) of 0x2000
WUX: sector size, uncompressed size, sector index table (deduplicated)

magic.note: .wua = ZArchive, footer at end of file

formats.header: ZArchive: zstd-compressed blocks, name table, footer with section offsets
NUS content: FST in content 0, AES-128-CBC with title key
GX2 surface headers; tiled by addrlib
File count 0x4, string table size 0x8, 0x18-byte entries; .nsz carries NCZ files (NCZSECTN at 0x4000)
RSA signature 0x0, secure area start 0x104, cart type 0x10D, HFS0 header offset 0x130/size 0x138; root HFS0 (update/normal/secure)
0xC00 encrypted header: distribution, content type, key generation, title ID, 4 FS entries, key area; sections PFS0 or RomFS (IVFC/BKTR)
Flags 0xC (LZ4 per segment), text/rodata/data segment headers 0x10..0x3C, module ID 0x40, compressed sizes 0x60; MOD0 inside text
Size 0x18, segment table 0x20, BSS 0x38, module ID 0x40
Kernel initial process, program metadata, application control property
SD-card AES-XTS container
BNTX NX: BRTI texture info, Tegra block-linear swizzled BCn/ASTC
Full list with descriptors in crates/aphrody-nie-formats/src/lib.rs (FormatDescriptor); see packages/iecode-docs/nie/FORMATS.md and formats/VFS-FORMAT-SPECIFICATIONS.md

magic.hex: 00 ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff 00

formats.header: CUE: FILE/TRACK MODE1|MODE2/2352|AUDIO/INDEX lines; PS1/PS2 boot from SYSTEM.CNF (BOOT=cdrom:\SLUS_xxx.xx;1 or BOOT2=cdrom0:...)
v5: compressors[4] 0x10, logical size 0x20, map offset 0x28, metadata offset 0x30, hunk bytes 0x38, unit bytes 0x3C, SHA-1s 0x40/0x54/0x68; CD tracks in CHT2 metadata
Error-code-stripped raw CD sectors
0x800 header: PC 0x10, GP 0x14, load address 0x18, size 0x1C, stack 0x30/0x34, region marker 0x4C

magic.note: .mcr 128 KiB raw card (16 blocks of 8 KiB)

formats.header: Memory card directory frames 1..15; TIM: flags 0x4 (bpp, CLUT)

magic.note: version: 01 PS1, 02 PS2, 11 Saturn, 12 Dreamcast, 21 N64, 22 GBA, 23 SNES

formats.header: Reserved size 0x4, compressed program size 0x8, CRC32 0xC, zlib program, [TAG] block
DVD ISO 9660 (+UDF bridge); dual-layer second layer start in PVD

magic.note: header size 0x18 @4, total size u64 @8, block size @0x10, version @0x14, align @0x15, then u32 index

formats.header: Block index with high-bit 'uncompressed' flag; .gz = PCSX2 indexed gzip
8 MiB card, 512+16-byte pages, FAT-like cluster table

magic.note: ROMDIR entry table (16-byte entries: name[10], extinfo size, file size) begins with RESET, ROMDIR, EXTINFO

formats.header: ROM0 = kernel + IOP modules indexed by ROMDIR; ROMVER holds version/region/date
Version 0x4 then 8 offsets: PARAM.SFO, ICON0.PNG, ICON1.PMF, PIC0.PNG, PIC1.PNG, SND0.AT3, DATA.PSP, DATA.PSAR (PS1 classics: PSISOIMG/PSTITLEIMG)
PSP_GAME/SYSDIR/EBOOT.BIN, PSP_GAME/PARAM.SFO, UMD_DATA.BIN
~PSP header: attributes, compressed size, elf size, tag 0xD0
Version 0x4, key table 0x8, data table 0xC, entry count 0x10; keys TITLE, TITLE_ID, CATEGORY, APP_VER
PKG revision 0x4, type 0x6 (1 PS3, 2 PSP/Vita), metadata offset 0x8, item count 0x14, data offset/size 0x20/0x28, content ID 0x30, digest/IV 0x60/0x70
SCE header: version, key revision, header type, metadata offset; ELF + program/section headers follow
Blu-ray ISO 9660/UDF with PS3_GAME/PARAM.SFO and USRDIR/EBOOT.BIN
Homebrew install package
PKG: entry table, PFS image (pfs_image.dat), content ID 0x40

magic.note: relative to the game partition; repeated at 0x107EC

formats.header: Root dir sector 0x10014, root size 0x10018; Redump images prefix a video partition (game partition at 0x18300000 XGD1, 0xFD90000 XGD2, 0x2080000 XGD3)
Base address 0x104 (0x10000), certificate 0x118, section count/headers 0x11C/0x120, entry point 0x128 (XOR-encoded), kernel thunk 0x158 (XOR-encoded)
Xbox 360 executable: module flags, PE data offset, security info, optional headers (not an original-Xbox format)
Xbox packed resource (swizzled NV2A textures)
Domestic title 0x120, overseas title 0x150, serial 0x180, checksum 0x18E, I/O 0x190, ROM range 0x1A0, RAM range 0x1A8, SRAM 0x1B0, region 0x1F0; 32X security program at ROM 0x400..0x7FF
Checksum 0x7FFA, product code 0x7FFC, region/size 0x7FFF
Volume header, system header (IP/SP), region-specific security code
IP.BIN: maker 0x10, product 0x20, version 0x2A, date 0x30, device 0x38, area 0x40, peripherals 0x50, title 0x60, IP size 0xE0, 1st read address 0xF0

magic.note: .gdi text: track count line then 'n lba type sectorsize file offset'
.cdi: u32 version (0x80000004/5/6) then u32 header offset at end of file

formats.header: IP.BIN: hardware ID, maker 0x10, device info 0x20, area 0x30, product 0x40, version 0x4A, date 0x50, boot file 0x60 (1ST_READ.BIN), title 0x80

magic.note: VMS header: description 0x00, long description 0x10, creator 0x30, icon count 0x40

formats.header: 128 KiB VMU flash, 512-byte blocks, FAT at block 254
